method: Retain four observed, vendor-specific index and endpoint quantities with their denominator and selection rules; do not replace a channel account by a unique human creator or confuse subscriber stock with current publishing activity.
population: Four dated vendor-indexed YouTube channel frames, not all channel accounts, all uploaders, all paying creators, or all unique humans worldwide

frames.sampling_frame: public indexed YouTube channels with >=1 public subscriber
frames.limitations: At least one subscriber, indexed vendor coverage; includes idle channels and excludes zero-subscriber or unindexed channels.

frames.sampling_frame: channels with >=1 public subscriber at window start AND net increase in public video count
frames.limitations: Net increase of public video objects can omit actual uploads canceled by removals, private visibility, deletions or a no-net-change period. The selected subset is not all observed active posting.

frames.sampling_frame: <1000 subscribers and >=1 public video at baseline 360 days earlier, endpoint counts present, nonnegative net video count delta
frames.limitations: Channels had under 1,000 subs and at least one public video at baseline, both visible endpoints and nonnegative public video count changes; not a pure newly launched channel cohort.

frames.sampling_frame: vendor indexed YouTube channels with at least 1,000 subscribers
frames.limitations: Different provider index, coverage, date and threshold; counts cannot be added to or subtracted from vidIQ samples to estimate churn or business growth.

distinct_population_definitions.minimum_evidence: A platform or vendor channel ID within a specified observation frame
distinct_population_definitions.not_equivalent_to: one distinct individual creator or an active publisher

distinct_population_definitions.minimum_evidence: Legitimate deduplicated ownership data with business/organization roles
distinct_population_definitions.not_equivalent_to: a public channel title or ID

distinct_population_definitions.minimum_evidence: Actual public/private lifecycle events, time window and right-censoring with authorized tracking
distinct_population_definitions.not_equivalent_to: a single net difference in count of public video objects

distinct_population_definitions.minimum_evidence: YPP authorization, active module, net reported receipts and clear account controls
Independent labor and receipt data including zero earners, unapproved and failed attempts
distinct_population_definitions.not_equivalent_to: sponsor rate card, video view, or observed large channel

sampling_design_next: Fix the first-publication date for new entrants with legitimate evidence before classifying channels as new.
Do not use subscriber count alone to infer the age of a channel.
Keep first upload and first channel creation as different clocks.
Select niches by explicit content inclusion predicate and match geography, format and observation time.
Include zero-subscriber channels, invisible/deleted channels and entrants who never published where the target frame includes them.
Record repeat channel snapshots and actual dated uploads where available, not just net video-count changes.
Estimate earning creator population only from valid paid status and receipt records, including nonmonetized and zero earning.
